<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
defer tadi-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 120

This plan rescues the three elderly and three adults at Myagang temple and defers the two cooperative members at Tadi farm. Myagang temple is not a designated evacuation point, so all rescued people go to Tarkeshwar shelter.

Rescuing the Tadi farm pair too would require a detour of 22 + 22 minutes from Myagang temple, for a total cost of 124. That is 4 minutes more than deferring them (penalty 40 for two adults), so I've chosen the deferral. If the team wants everyone moved in this wave, the alternative is: drive to Myagang, load 2 adults, go to Tadi farm, load the 2 cooperative members, return to Myagang, load the rest, and return to Tarkeshwar. Note that the Shivapuri farm roads are excluded from this plan because of the collapse and the swept-away truck.
